Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 80: February 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #80 shipped to subscribers in January 2008 (bearing the cover date of February 2008 for Issue 80). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #80 delivered a stacked late-winter lineup of high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, and exclusive media content:

Dark Sector (third-person sci-fi action shooter)
Lost Odyssey (turn-based tactical JRPG)
Frontlines: Fuel of War (large-scale military FPS)
N+ (Xbox Live Arcade high-speed ninja platformer)
Poker XBLA (Xbox Live Arcade card game suite)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom downloadable dashboard themes and gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including featurettes for Grand Theft Auto IV, Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, Fallout 3, and Army of Two, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
